B1.rationale: System Z provides the widest verified original-language and LXX grounding, uncovering extra wordplays and chains (Mic 1:15 אבי/יבא, Phlm 20 ναι/οναιμην, full εχω chain, μαλιστα/μαλλον, and Παυλος vs παυω negative control). System Y is a very close second (catching a tool false positive on Χριστος/χρηστος and the 5x יושבת / speaker-shift frame), while System X is a strong but unverified baseline report whose promised Section 4 verification ledger is missing.

B2.rationale: System X delivers verified MT/Swete-LXX/NA28 alignments without textual errors, adds 1 Pet 3:14-15 (LXX Isa 8:12-13) and Eph 2:20 as sharp controls, and accurately traces the 1 Pet 2:6 adjective reordering. System Z contributes standout LXX/NT insights (Acts 4:11 οικοδομων matching MT הבנים and μαας->εξουθενεω, Hab 2:3a ορασις gender) but misquotes 1 Pet 2:6's word order and contradicts itself in the comparison, while unverified System Y slips on LXX Isa 28:16 (ιδου) and 1 Pet 2:7 (λιθον for λιθος).

B3.rationale: System X leads with exceptional verified discoveries—LXX Amos 1:3 assimilating 1:13's pregnant women, Σαλωμων in Amos 1:6/9, the Amos 2:13 hapax עוק, the 3-verse ארץ+שמים+אור intersection, zero lemma overlap in Jer 4:24 and 4:26, and permutation-tested boundary breaks. System Z is a close second with Masoretic פ/ס delimitations, Prov 30's 3/4 bridge, and refrain-chiasm debunking in both Amos and Gen 1, while System Y offers strong unverified Gen 1 Day-by-Day synthesis without primary-text grounding.

B4.rationale: System Y dominates B4 with complete verified Hebrew/Aramaic/Greek coverage (including Ps 12:6 עליל->δοκιμιον, Prov 27:21 LXX, Zech 13:9->1 Pet 1:7, Isa 1:25 LXX demetaphorization, and 1 Cor 3:12-15 thermal stability) plus impeccable epistemic separation. System X is well-grounded in cupellation and alkali fluxing but narrower in corpus scope and ends with a dangling reference to a missing Section 6, while unverified System Z has brilliant metallurgy (galena, blick, PbO glaze) marred by LXX false positives (σκωρια in LXX Prov 25:4/Isa 1:22,25/Ezek 22:18 and χωνευω in LXX Zech 13:9).

B5.rationale: System Z excels with statistically verified diptych alignment (Judg 19:14-30 vs Gen 19:1-29), rare bridges beyond surface vocabulary (Exod 29:17/Lev 1:6 sacrificial נתח->1 Sam 11:7, Job 31:32, Ezek 16:49-50, Ps 95:6-9 προσκυνεω+Πειρασμος, Neh 11:1, Esth 1:4, Dan 3:6), and crisp orthographic controls (נבלה/נבלה). System X is a strong second with exclusive OT intersections and the cross-axis ענה contrast, while unverified System Y adds creative bridges (Josh 8:14-21, Matt 28:16-20) without primary-text verification.

B6.rationale: System X integrates all five canonical trajectories—uniquely tying Josh 6:26, 1 Kgs 16:34, Josh 16:1 (מי יריחו to Bethel), and 2 Kgs 2:19-24 together alongside 2 Kgs 4:38-41, 1 Kgs 18:34 (υδριας), and Ezek 43:24/47:8-11—while backing every hypothesis with explicit counterexamples. System Z adds brilliant lexical discoveries (מוצא מים vs מוצא שפה->Jas 3:11-12, 2 Kgs 21:13 צלחת bookend, Jer 17:6/16, Josh 15:62) but misses the primary Jericho-Bethel curse bridge and 2 Kgs 4:38-41, and System Y remains unverified.
